author: Hank Green
description:
In March I made a video about my biggest AI fears. One was that this is a bubble and that the people in charge seemed like the had a lot of ability to be less reckless but were not being careful with the economy. That turns out to have been true in a way that I did not expect, but I think the point certainly stands...
